stories.title: RBI raises repo rate as inflation risks widen, delaying cuts
stories.summary: The RBI’s Monetary Policy Committee increased the benchmark repo rate by 25 basis points to address rising inflation concerns. Governor Sanjay Malhotra said inflation is broadening, with many commodities above 4%; Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta highlighted external supply‑side shocks, and external members warned that an aggressive hike could weigh on growth.

stories.title: Jio Platforms IPO day 2 sees 22% grey‑market premium, valuation up to Rs 10.3 lakh crore
stories.summary: On day two of its Rs 30,213 crore IPO, Jio Platforms recorded a grey‑market premium of about 22 percent. The issue, priced between Rs 1,065 and Rs 1,119 per share, is set to close on October 23. At the top of the price range the company’s market value is estimated at roughly Rs 10.3 lakh crore, with brokerages noting its telecom leadership and growth prospects in broadband and AI.
stories.why: The strong premium signals robust investor demand, which may lift sentiment in Indian equity markets.

stories.title: Extent of rate hike cycle to depend on growth-inflation outlook: RBI Governor
stories.summary: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Governor Sanjay Malhotra said the duration and extent of the rate hike cycle will be contingent on the actual growth-inflation developments and outlook. The governor and other five Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) members voted to raise the repo rate by 25 bps to 5.5 per cent.

stories.title: JD Vance urges Republicans to stop criticizing Ohio attack ad
stories.summary: JD Vance told fellow Republicans to stop “whining” about a controversial Ohio campaign advertisement that featured Donna Arthur, the estranged mother of Democratic candidate Amy Acton, accusing her daughter of lying her entire life. The ad did not mention that Arthur’s husband had been charged with raping Acton as a child. The campaign of Republican gubernatorial candidate Vivek Ramaswamy claimed credit for the ad and spent millions on statewide broadcasts, while Acton’s brother condemned it as a “despicable low.”
stories.why: The episode shows intra‑party tension and the use of personal attacks in political campaigning, which can affect party unity and voter attitudes.
